searchText: <@543900561460822016> What is the spec of `b11r`(cc <@450651770243252225>). So far I'm really trying to avoid RLP. yeah is this essentially the whole thing b11r does -> take json of block pieces and create 1) block rlp and 2) block hash No execution? no execution https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/tree/master/cmd/evm#block-builder-tool-b11r spec ^ _someone_ has to do it and the python testing framework posits that clients should do this work (today retesteth does it) Doing JSON → RLP should be fine. But can we agree to pass transactions as JSON too? well t8n already outputs tx rlp `--output.body` In `evmone-t8n` we take `txs.json` not `txs.rlp`. yes, t8n takes in txs.json, but can output rlp txs with `--output.body` Wait, do you use ethash? ah yeah, it has sealing functionality Does it still relies on ethash? How do you do it post-Merge? right now it uses clique that is, the execution spec tests use clique Can't we mock CL? this all goes into the hive consensus tests pipeline where each EL client just imports and rlp list of blocks so CL is completely circumvented BTW is block reward applied before or after transactions execution? it's after!
